name: Default
shortDescription: Virtual office presented as a 16-bit RPG world where walking up to colleagues opens audio and video conversations in the browser.

alerts.message: Anyone with the URL can join anonymously and, by default, edit maps uploaded to map-storage with the inline map editor. Video calls are peer-to-peer with at most 4 people per bubble. Sign-in, a restricted map editor, larger meetings and users behind strict firewalls need OpenID Connect, LiveKit and TURN settings (OPENID_*, MAP_EDITOR_*, LIVEKIT_*, TURN_*), which you add to the play and back services yourself.
